claim_restated: Pan-cancer, tumors with a pathogenic/likely-pathogenic germline predisposition variant (in genes incl. BRCA1) show loss of heterozygosity or a biallelic two-hit event at that locus in this fraction of cases
source_population: 677 predisposition-variant-bearing tumors (659 SNV/indel + 18 large deletions) across 33 TCGA cancer types, n=10389 adult cancers total cohort
citation: Huang KL et al. "Pathogenic Germline Variants in 10,389 Adult Cancers." Cell. 2018 Apr 5;173(2):355-370.e14.
applies_to_design_note: Pan-cancer ceiling for expected LOH/two-hit rate; our design's per-carrier LOH rate should not be interpreted against this alone without the breast-specific, gene-stratified numbers in LOH02.

claim_restated: In germline BRCA1 carriers' breast tumors, locus-specific LOH (loss of the wild-type allele) is present in this fraction; in germline BRCA2 carriers' breast tumors, in this fraction
source_population: 160 germline BRCA1/BRCA2-associated breast and ovarian tumors (retention of wild-type allele reported in 10% of BRCA1 breast, 46% of BRCA2 breast, 7% of BRCA1 ovarian, 16% of BRCA2 ovarian tumors; LOH = complement)
citation: Maxwell KN et al. "BRCA locus-specific loss of heterozygosity in germline BRCA1 and BRCA2 carriers." Nat Commun. 2017 Aug 22;8:319.
applies_to_design_note: Primary, gene- and tissue-stratified LOH benchmark for our breast-cancer design; BRCA2 breast LOH (54%) is materially lower than BRCA1 breast (90%) and should not be pooled.

claim_restated: In high-grade serous ovarian carcinoma overall (not stratified by BRCA status), the homologous-recombination pathway is estimated defective/deficient in about this fraction of tumors
source_population: 489 HGSOC profiled (mRNA/miRNA/methylation/copy number), 316 exome-sequenced
citation: The Cancer Genome Atlas Research Network. "Integrated genomic analyses of ovarian carcinoma." Nature. 2011 Jun 30;474(7353):609-615.
applies_to_design_note: Foundational, unstratified HRD prevalence estimate for HGSOC; establishes the ~50% baseline our design's expected HRD-high proportion should be compared against, but is not BRCA-mutant-vs-wild-type stratified (see HRD02, NF01).

claim_restated: A combined DNA-based HRD score (unweighted sum of LOH, TAI, and LST components) is correlated with BRCA1/2 defects across breast cancer subtypes, providing the analytic basis subsequently used to define an HRD-positive threshold
value: correlation established (no single percent reported for this claim)
source_population: 215 breast tumors across all ER/HER2 subtypes, commercial specimens
citation: Timms KM et al. "Association of BRCA1/2 defects with genomic scores predictive of DNA damage repair deficiency among breast cancer subtypes." Breast Cancer Res. 2014 Dec 5;16(6):475.
applies_to_design_note: Methodological basis for the composite HRD (LOH+TAI+LST) score our design would compute; precedes and underlies the GIS>=42 threshold in HRD03.

claim_restated: The established genomic-instability-score (GIS) threshold for HRD-positive status is this value; it was used to define HR-deficiency (score >=42, or a BRCA1/2 mutation) and shown to predict pathologic response to platinum-based neoadjuvant chemotherapy in triple-negative breast cancer
source_population: 267 TNBC patients pooled across 3 neoadjuvant platinum trials incl. PrECOG 0105 (n=72)
citation: Telli ML et al. "Homologous Recombination Deficiency (HRD) Score Predicts Response to Platinum-Containing Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy in Patients with Triple-Negative Breast Cancer." Clin Cancer Res. 2016 Aug 1;22(15):3764-73.
applies_to_design_note: This is the specific GIS>=42 cutoff our design should use if adopting the Myriad myChoice-style composite score; clinical-benefit validation (not just biomarker-response) is in HRD04.

claim_restated: Clinical (treatment-benefit) validation of the GIS threshold: adding olaparib to bevacizumab maintenance produced a progression-free-survival benefit in newly diagnosed advanced ovarian cancer, concentrated in the HRD-positive (BRCA-mutant and/or GIS>=42) subgroup
source_population: 806 patients, phase III PAOLA-1/ENGOT-ov25 trial
citation: Ray-Coquard I et al. "Olaparib plus Bevacizumab as First-Line Maintenance in Ovarian Cancer." N Engl J Med. 2019.
applies_to_design_note: Establishes that the GIS>=42 threshold (HRD03) has clinical-outcome validation, not just biomarker correlation -- the relevant citation if our design frames HRD-high status as clinically actionable.

claim_restated: HGSOC HRD-high proportion stratified by BRCA1/2 mutation status (BRCA-mutant % vs BRCA-wild-type %), from a single primary source with a confirmed resolving URL

claim_restated: In a large hereditary-panel-testing-referred breast cancer cohort (white patients), carrier prevalence of a pathogenic/likely-pathogenic germline variant in CHEK2, ATM, and PALB2 respectively
source_population: 38326 white breast-cancer patients referred for 25-31-gene hereditary panel testing (Ambry Genetics, 2012-2016), vs 26911 ExAC-NFE controls
citation: Couch FJ et al. "Associations Between Cancer Predisposition Testing Panel Genes and Breast Cancer." JAMA Oncol. 2017;3(9):1190-1196.

This is a panel-testing-referred cohort, NOT TCGA-BRCA itself and NOT an unselected population -- prevalence in an unselected cohort would likely be lower (see BRCA_PREV01's own unselected-vs-clinically-tested contrast in the same research trail, GATE_HOUSEKEEPING-style caveat recorded in SIMULATION_SPEC.md). Extrapolating both rows to a ~1097-patient TCGA-BRCA-scale cohort (arithmetic done in SIMULATION_SPEC.md, not itself a published figure) gives ~55-75 realistic CORE_HR carriers and ~25-35 realistic DDR_SIGNALING carriers -- the basis for this simulator's raised-n justification.
